facts.note: Refusal to show the watch is present ('I kept mine in my pocket'), and sitting alone with the brandy and hearing the temple strike ten without looking at the watch match. But the sheet places the refusal 'at dinner', while the transcript places the watch-showing 'At nine', after dinner.
Went out into the street at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started just as he lit the cigar at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch, and stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch, faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.
Came back in at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; went up to Félix in the library.

added.quote: At nine Monnier had made us all show our watches
added.why: Gives a clock time of day (nine) for the watch-showing at the table, placing an event between dinner and the temple striking ten, which the fact sheet does not give.
